title: automobile/models
description: One row per model produced by one manufacturer. The model range. A model defines the segment, body style and engine envelope; individual cars in the vehicles table inherit those characteristics and vary within them.

manufacturer_id.description: Who makes this model. Every model belongs to exactly one manufacturer.

name.description: Full model name, manufacturer plus model line, as it would appear in a brochure or a listing.

segment.description: European vehicle segment, the classification the industry itself uses: A is a city car, C a family hatchback, E an executive saloon, plus SUV, MPV and Van as body-led categories.

body_type.description: Body style, always one that is plausible for the segment -- you will not find an A-segment estate car, because nobody builds one.

year_from.description: First model year this version was produced. Vehicles in this dataset are never older than their model's launch.

year_to.description: Last model year produced, or empty if the model is still in production -- which is the case for about 40% of rows.

base_price.description: List price when new, in euros, scaled to the segment. This is the figure depreciation is applied to when valuing a used example.
